questions.q: The average outstanding education loan per account rose over 10 years to:
questions.explanation: **₹7.25 lakh**, up 178%, even as the number of accounts fell 15.2%.
questions.fact_text: RBI data: education loan accounts fell **15.2%** (25.76 lakh in June 2016 to 21.84 lakh in June 2026), but average loan per account rose **178%** to **₹7.25 lakh**; education loans' share of bank credit fell from 0.93% to 0.74%.

questions.q: Cyclone Murasu crossed the coast near which town?
questions.explanation: Near **Ongole** (Prakasam district, A.P.): 2 deaths and ₹344 crore of damage.
questions.fact_text: Severe cyclonic storm **Murasu** crossed the coast near **Ongole** (Prakasam district, A.P.) on 3 Nov at 110-120 km/h: **2 deaths**, crops on **52,459 ha** hit, losses put at **₹344 crore**; Guntur, Bapatla and Palnadu worst hit. It came a week after Cyclone **Arnab**.

also.text: Cyclones in the north Indian Ocean are named from a list prepared by the **WMO/ESCAP Panel on Tropical Cyclones** (13 member countries); the **IMD** (Regional Specialised Meteorological Centre, **New Delhi**) assigns the names in turn.

questions.q: The Kedartal trek, where an avalanche left eight missing, is in which district?
questions.explanation: **Uttarkashi**, Uttarakhand; treks above **4,000 m** were suspended.
questions.fact_text: An avalanche on the **Kedartal** trek (**Uttarkashi**, Uttarakhand) left eight missing (two bodies found); permits for treks above **4,000 m** were suspended.

questions.q: How many Indian seafarers have died since the West Asia conflict began in February 2026?
questions.explanation: **23**, the latest on the MSV Al Jusufi off Oman.
questions.fact_text: An Indian seafarer, **Gandhar Nahim Ajij** (Gujarat), was killed when a drone hit the vessel **MSV Al Jusufi** off **Oman**; 13 Indians were rescued by Oman's navy. This took Indian seafarer deaths since the West Asia war began (Feb 2026) to **23**. MEA spokesperson: **Randhir Jaiswal**.

questions.q: The Indian Navy rescued the crew of which fishing vessel from pirates in November 2026?
questions.explanation: The Iranian vessel **Azini**, about 3,000 km from Mumbai; 20 crew were saved.
questions.fact_text: The **Indian Navy**, backed by the IAF, rescued **20 Iranian crew** of the fishing vessel **Azini** from pirates about **3,000 km from Mumbai**, underlining India's role as 'first responder' in the Indian Ocean.

questions.q: At which forum did Rajnath Singh call for India's 'technological sovereignty'?
questions.explanation: The third **Delhi Defence Dialogue** at MP-IDSA.
questions.fact_text: Rajnath Singh at the third **Delhi Defence Dialogue** (MP-IDSA) called for **'technological sovereignty'**, naming four pillars: defence reforms, self-reliance, international collaboration and exports.

questions.q: 'Recursive self-improvement', flagged by Anthropic to the US SEC, means:
options: AI systems helping design more capable AI
AI models retraining on their own output
questions.explanation: **AI helping build its successors** faster than safety work can keep up.
questions.fact_text: **Anthropic** told the US SEC that AI could soon speed up the building of more powerful AI ('recursive self-improvement') faster than safety measures can keep up; it said over 90% of its September code contributions were written by **Claude**, and no current model has crossed that threshold.

questions.q: Binance's emergency fund used after the 2026 hack is called:
questions.explanation: The **Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU)**, set up in 2018; ~95% of the $6.3 bn was restored.
questions.fact_text: Editorial: **Binance** used its **SAFU** emergency fund (set up 2018) and its own money to restore about **95%** of the **$6.3 billion** stolen within four days; it urged India to regulate crypto instead of taxing it heavily.

also.text: India taxes gains from crypto (virtual digital assets) at a flat **30%**, with **1% TDS** on transfers, since **2022**.

questions.q: In Euhadra snails, the direction the shell coils is decided by:
options: The snail's own genes after hatching
questions.explanation: The **mother's** myosin gene — a maternal effect (*Current Biology*).
questions.fact_text: UK-Japan study (*Current Biology*): the direction a **Euhadra** snail's shell coils is set by the **mother's myosin gene** (a 'maternal effect'): one S (sinistral) copy in the mother gives left-handed offspring.

questions.q: Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana is a scheme of which State?
questions.explanation: **Maharashtra** (2024): ₹1,500 a month for women aged 21-65.
questions.fact_text: Women protested in Mumbai over pending instalments of Maharashtra's **Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana** (₹1,500 a month; ₹2,100 had been promised), led by **AIDWA**.

also.text: **Majhi Ladki Bahin Yojana** (Maharashtra, 2024) gives monthly aid to women aged **21-65** from low-income families.

questions.q: Which body did the Congress approach over students in Prayagraj selling blood to pay coaching fees?
questions.explanation: The **National Human Rights Commission**.
questions.fact_text: Congress asked the **NHRC** to act on reports of NEET and SSC aspirants in Prayagraj selling blood to pay coaching fees (₹1.2-1.8 lakh a year).

questions.q: Jimmy Carter, elected on 4 Nov 1976, was which US President?
questions.explanation: The **39th**, beating Gerald Ford.
questions.fact_text: From the archives (4 Nov 1976): **Jimmy Carter** was elected the **39th US President**, defeating Gerald Ford, the only President never elected to the office or the vice-presidency.

questions.q: The World Day Against the Death Penalty is observed on:
questions.explanation: **10 October**.
questions.fact_text: The **World Day Against the Death Penalty** is observed on **10 October**.

questions.q: The Asian Champions Trophy 2026 knockouts moved from Jalandhar to:
questions.explanation: **Mohali** (Olympian Balbir Singh stadium); the league was at the Olympian Surjit stadium, Jalandhar.
questions.fact_text: Asian Champions Trophy semis move to **Mohali** (Olympian **Balbir Singh** stadium; the league was at the Olympian **Surjit** stadium, Jalandhar): India vs **Korea**, Malaysia vs Japan. India had beaten Korea 8-0.

questions.q: Meghalaya identified how many villages to preserve indigenous traditions?
questions.explanation: **11** villages, announced by CM Conrad K. Sangma.
questions.fact_text: Meghalaya (CM **Conrad K. Sangma**) identified **11 villages** to preserve indigenous traditions and support artisans.
